Definition: from a derivative of σάττω (to equip) meaning furniture, especially a pack-saddle (which in the East is merely a bag of netted rope); a "seine" for fishing:--net.
BiblicalUsage: Sagḗnē is the word for a "seine" for fishing. It stands in Matthew 13:47: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto…".
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that one mention of sagḗnē is enough, because God wastes no words.
